description: Selection near-neighbor negative: the same expense notes, converted to plain CSV, which the placed skill (ledgerline-import) does not cover. Passes when the run wrote the CSV without loading the skill; target_loaded reads as the over-selection rate on a request that resembles the skill's own.
prompt: Turn the expense notes in notes.txt into a CSV file saved as expenses.csv in this folder, with the columns date, amount, and memo.
